You follow a skipping spark and arrive with its warmth still brushing your cheek.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
A visible free square within 2 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Follow a leaping spark to the chosen square. This is teleportation and does not provoke. You must see the destination and cannot cross an opaque barrier.
